signals.entity: BORICA AD (national card & payment infrastructure operator)
signals.signal: At a BORICA business event reported 09/07/2026, BORICA announced a roadmap for a CENTRALISED NATIONAL FRAUD-PREVENTION MODEL inside the 'blink' instant-payment agreement, in partnership with Portuguese processor SIBS: the project started at the beginning of 2026, the national concept and rulebook are to be agreed by END-2026, and MARKET IMPLEMENTATION STARTS IN 2027. BORICA also presented a Pre-Transaction Risk Assessment solution built on IBM Safer Payments, and confirmed its EPC-certified Verification of Payee (Qualified RVM) service has been live since October 2025. BNB Payment Oversight (director Mihail Dimov; head of unit Plamen Randzhev) presented findings of a thematic supervisory review of payment-transaction monitoring and said PSD3/PSR final texts are expected to be published by end-2026, after which PSPs get a 21-month compliance window. Bulgarian fraud data cited: credit-transfer fraud ~70% of losses (~EUR 7.9m); IBAN-substitution fraud EUR 13m in 2025 (GDBOP); 24,755 card-fraud cases in a year; instant transfers up 87% to EUR 35bn.
signals.implies: Two-sided. (a) Competitive: BORICA+IBM Safer Payments+SIBS are positioning to own centralised fraud scoring, squeezing per-bank platforms. (b) Opportunity: the BNB supervisor explicitly said formal monitoring mechanisms will NOT be enough and demands real-time, behaviour-based, pre-execution monitoring - every Bulgarian PSP must upgrade its OWN monitoring layer regardless of the central model. That is a direct INETCO transaction-monitoring and IMTF Siron / FICO AML window, with a hard clock (rulebook end-2026, implementation 2027, PSR +21 months).
signals.followup: Build a Bulgaria PSD3/PSR fraud-monitoring play for tier-2/3 banks and payment institutions that will NOT build their own; target the end-2026 rulebook window. Obtain the BNB thematic-review findings from BNB Payment Oversight.
